name: sales-enablement
description: Sales coaching and practice for sellers. Coach a sales call with quotes from the call; quiz reps on your own pricing or product notes; rehearse with a practice buyer who reveals facts only when asked the right question; plan a demo where each segment answers a need the buyer named; find buyer questions your team answers differently, without proof or not at all; and work out how long a new seller needs before selling alone, against your coaching hours. Built from your material, plus a few dated, cited public facts used only when they change the answer; nothing invented except clearly labelled fictional role-play details. Scores are practice feedback, not a basis for hiring, pay or dismissal, and sellers are never ranked.

interface.longDescription: Five skills for whoever gets sellers ready. Call coaching reads one to five transcripts or call notes and tells the seller what to say differently at the moments that mattered, with quotes from the call, talk share, an optional score with its basis, and one practice exercise. Sales role-play and quiz writes a quiz from your own pricing or product notes with a separate answer key and a list of topics your notes do not cover, and plays a fictional buyer who reveals the facts you supply only when the rep asks the right question, then scores the rep with quotes by turn. Demo runbook plans one segment per need the buyer named, with what not to show and a timed agenda that adds up to the slot, or checks a script you have. Question bank reads three or more conversations, finds the buyer questions your sellers answer differently, without proof or not at all, and proposes one answer from your material. Ramp plan builds a week-by-week plan for a new seller from your role, sales cycle and coach hours, and checks whether the coach's hours cover it. Scores are practice feedback for the person coached, never input to hiring, pay or dismissal; sellers are not ranked or compared. Built from your material plus a few dated, cited public facts used only when they change the answer; nothing invented except clearly labelled fictional role-play details.
defaultPrompt: 30-min demo for a VP Support. Pains: first reply takes 9 hours, no weekend cover. We have AI triage, shared inbox, reports.
Make a 10-question rep quiz with answer key from these rules: Pro $40/seat, min 10 seats, annual only, max discount 15%.
Role-play a skeptical CFO at a 200-person logistics firm. I sell route-planning software. Score me when I say stop.
